items.title: Study Tracks 3,000 Real-World Psychedelic Journeys
items.snippet: Most psychedelic journeys don't happen in hospital clinics. items.title: How Primates Stitch Visual Meaning Across Eye Movements
items.snippet: How do humans and monkeys find continuous meaning in a movie? City College of New York researchers tracked eye movements and neural firing, discovering a rapid "semantic novelty signal" that bridges visual glimpses to predict scene meaning.
